name: CapCut Documentary Parallax Collage
use_when: A documentary or explainer needs several cutout images, historical figures, concepts, or source elements to feel like a designed 3D scene.
Foreground cutouts, background atmosphere, and text can move at different intensities to create depth.
A still-image sequence needs a premium transition or chapter-like graphic without leaving CapCut.
avoid_when: The claim would be clearer as a simple map, chart, or document hold.
The cutout sources are low resolution, unlicensed, generated without labeling, or misleading as evidence.
The motion would hide the subject, title text, or source context.

timeline_pattern.pattern: long_background -> mist_rain_or_texture -> cutout_sequence -> fade_overlap_images -> compound_cutouts -> plan_spatial_targets -> transform_keyframes -> cubic_ease_scale_x_y -> paste_reduced_motion_to_background -> text_behind_or_between_cutouts -> global_texture_grade -> qc
timeline_pattern.planning_rule: Roughly assign where each image should live before animating: bottom, top, left, center, or behind a subject.
timeline_pattern.fade_rule: Overlap image fades so the next subject arrives as the previous subject clears, not as a hard unrelated cut.
timeline_pattern.parallax_rule: Foreground/cutout motion should be stronger than background motion; after copying motion to the background, reduce scale and position changes.
timeline_pattern.text_depth_rule: Place title text behind or between cutouts only when it stays readable and reinforces depth.

motion.rule: Create depth by combining staggered cutout fades, eased compound transforms, subtler background movement, and optional low-strength texture motion.

keyframe_values.image_duration: Five seconds per image can be a planning default when no voiceover timing exists; trim to narration once known.
keyframe_values.fade_out: A 0.5s fade out is a usable starting point for image transitions in a calm documentary collage.
keyframe_values.fade_in: Use short opacity keyframes from 0 to 100% over a few frames when built-in fade-in control is not available.
keyframe_values.easing: Apply Cubic Ease to scale, X, and Y curves after each round of keyframe changes.
keyframe_values.background_motion: Paste foreground location/size motion to the background only as a starting point, then reduce zoom and position shifts so parallax remains subtle.
keyframe_values.ambient_effects: Mist/rain speed and atmosphere should be low enough to add life without becoming the subject.
keyframe_values.pendulum_texture: Low-strength Play Pendulum can add subtle drift only after captions, titles, cutouts, and proof remain readable.

sound.rule: Use restrained whooshes, risers, ambience, or texture only on major subject transitions; avoid cueing every small cutout move.

captions.rule: Suppress or reposition captions during dense title/cutout moments; captions should return when designed text clears.

color.rule: Unify cutouts and background with a global adjustment layer only after local cutout color and mask edges are acceptable.

keyframe_values.hsl_unification: Shift dominant reds/yellows/oranges toward a shared palette only as far as needed to unify sources.
keyframe_values.vignette_particles: Use vignette and particles lightly; reduce if edges, title text, or source detail become muddy.

implementation.ffmpeg: Sequence alpha cutouts with fades, compose over a textured background, keyframe scale/position at scene targets, apply eased expressions, add lower-intensity background transforms, and overlay text between layers when supported by alpha order.
implementation.remotion: Create a DocumentaryParallaxCollage component with backgroundAsset, atmosphereLayers, cutoutAssets, spatialTargets, keyframes, backgroundMotionMultiplier, textDepthLayers, and rights metadata.
implementation.blender: Use image planes at different Z depths, camera moves, mist/rain planes, text planes behind cutouts, and color-management/grain passes.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Extend the background longer than needed, add mist/rain effects, remove backgrounds on images, feather harsh edges, fade image entrances/exits, compound the image sequence, add transform keyframes through planned subject positions, apply Cubic Ease to scale/X/Y, paste location-size attributes to the background and reduce them, then add blended text behind cutouts and a light global adjustment.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use nested cutout layers, opacity fades, eased Motion keyframes, adjustment layers for background atmosphere and grade, and After Effects/Essential Graphics for text depth when needed.

common_mistakes: Building the parallax move before deciding each image's story position.
Pasting identical motion onto the background and foreground, making the scene flat.
Failing to reapply easing after moving keyframes.
Using title text behind cutouts even when the covered letters become unreadable.
Adding mist, rain, pendulum, particles, and vignette until source material feels fake or muddy.
Using generated or downloaded cutouts without source/license status.
qc: Does each cutout have a clear story role and source/license status?
Do cutout edges stay clean after Remove Background, masks, fades, and texture?
Is foreground motion stronger than background motion without revealing empty edges?
Are titles readable when layered behind or between cutouts?
Do captions, source labels, and proof areas avoid the densest collage frames?
Does the final grade unify sources without hiding faces, text, or evidence?
